experiment_data.hypothesis: TEAL 30% training-free downstream eval — 与 KL 30% 对比，看 training-free baseline 在低 sparsity 下的 downstream 表现。配合 50% 数据点构建完整 sparsity-task tradeoff 曲线。

spec.command: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/distill_sparse_swiglu && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -u src/lm_eval_teal.py --sparsity_target 0.3 --tasks arc_challenge,winogrande,mmlu,gsm8k --gpu 0 --output_path results/lm_eval_teal_30pct

experiment_data.notes: TEAL 30% vs KL 30% vs Dense (0-shot): ARC-c acc_norm: TEAL=0.4155 > KL=0.3737 (+4.2pp), Dense=0.5819. WinoGrande: TEAL=0.6559 < KL=0.6756 (-2.0pp), Dense=0.7814. MMLU: TEAL=0.3598 > KL=0.2874 (+7.2pp), Dense=0.6532. GSM8K strict: TEAL=0.0849 ≈ KL=0.0743 (+1.1pp), Dense=0.5004. TEAL 在知识密集型任务(ARC-c, MMLU)上显著优于 KL distill，但在推理任务(GSM8K)上两者都崩溃严重。整体仍远低于 Dense baseline，30% sparsity 对 downstream 损害巨大。
